title: Word patch
statement: Given a tape $c_t\colon\mathbb{Z}\to\mathrm{Option}(\Gamma)$, an integer position $c_p$, and a finite word $u$ over $\Gamma$, define a new tape that stores the symbols of $u$ in the cells from $c_p$ through $c_p+|u|-1$, using the word’s positions relative to $c_p$, and agrees with $c_t$ at every other cell.
